top_band: medium brown top beam (rows 10-11) with lighter orange-brown front edge highlight (row 12)
evidence: Looking down a middle column: row 9 is dark brown outline, rows 10-11 are a medium brown top surface of the upper beam, row 12 is a 1px lighter orange-brown front edge highlight, row 13 is an eave shadow directly over the recessed warp threads (rows 14-21), followed by the lower beam (rows 22-24 with top edge and front face) and legs below (rows 26-31).

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul stall and well references, the loom is very geometric and blocky with unshaded flat horizontal bands for the wood beams, strictly repeating vertical 1px lines for the threads, and a simple 2x1 checkerboard pattern for the woven cloth. It lacks wood grain, organic pixel clustering, and rich value transitions.
